status: registered before atlas computation in this round
primary_population: odd integers 9 <= n < 512; prime versus composite
size_normalization: subtract feature mean within each dyadic bin, using every eligible integer without labels
directional_candidate: prime complexity defect exceeds size-matched composite defect
controls: labels shuffled within dyadic bins preserving counts
uniform sparse sets with identical dyadic counts (same null law, not independent evidence)
nearest-size odd composite matches with replacement
pass: positive finite held-out primary contrast surviving parity and listed size controls; observational only
fail: nonpositive held-out primary contrast or loss of contrast against the declared null controls
ambiguous: mixed diagnostic directions, insufficient subgroup size, or normalization-dependent result
exclusions: no RH inference, no universal crest claim, no fitted lift constant, no wall-clock cost
successor_cost: deferred to independently specified successor machine; not silently inferred from integer complexity
